name: MonarchRecordingIndicator
title: RecordingIndicator
wrapsNative: Text and Circle in a Capsule, TimelineView(.periodic), Duration.TimeFormatStyle
summary: A "REC" capsule with the recorded time, shown while a call or a session is recorded, with an optional stop button.
whenToUse: In a call or a session that is being recorded, so everyone can see it. Keep it in the layout while not recording, so starting and stopping are announced.
whenNotToUse: Not for the system's own microphone or camera indicators, which iOS draws itself.
api: init(isRecording: Bool, since: Date? = nil, elapsed: TimeInterval? = nil, variant: MonarchRecordingIndicatorVariant = .subtle, isPaused: Bool = false, labels: MonarchRecordingIndicatorLabels = MonarchRecordingIndicatorLabels(), showsElapsed: Bool? = nil, onStop: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchRecordingIndicatorLabels { init(rec: String? = nil, recording: String? = nil, paused: String? = nil, started: String? = nil, stopped: String? = nil, pausedAnnouncement: String? = nil, resumed: String? = nil, stop: String? = nil) }

options.name: isRecording
options.description: Whether recording is on. Nothing is drawn while false.

options.name: since
options.description: When recording started. The time advances from it every second.

options.name: elapsed
options.description: The recorded time in seconds, when the product counts it. Takes precedence over since and does not advance by itself.

options.name: variant
options.description: subtle on the app's surfaces, solid over video.

options.name: isPaused
options.description: The capsule says Paused, shows a pause glyph and the time stops.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the eight built-in strings.

options.name: showsElapsed
options.description: Whether the time is shown. By default it is shown when since or elapsed is given.

options.name: onStop
options.description: Stops recording. Adds a stop button.

states.name: recording
states.description: A pulsing dot, "REC" and the time.

states.name: paused
states.description: A pause glyph, "Paused" and a time that does not advance.

appearance: Subtle is a capsule in the subtle danger colour with a danger border and strong danger text. Solid is a capsule in the inverse background colour with inverse text. The dot is the solid danger colour in both.
platformNotes: The web variants are named badge and overlay; iOS uses the shared words subtle and solid for the same two looks. The web overlay is translucent; the iOS solid variant is opaque, because colours come from roles and are not dimmed. Strings are replaced through one labels value instead of a messages object. The time is formatted by Duration.TimeFormatStyle in the user's locale.
accessibility: The capsule is one element read as "Recording", or "Recording, Paused", with the time in words as its value.
Starting, stopping, pausing and resuming are each announced once; the advancing time is not announced.
The state is text and a glyph as well as colour.
The dot does not pulse when Reduce Motion is on.
The stop button is named "Stop recording" and has a 44-point touch target.
edgeCases: With since and isPaused the time shown is the time since the start at the last redraw, pauses included; pass elapsed to leave pauses out.
From one hour the time shows hours, for example 1:02:03.
A start date in the future shows 00:00.
If the view is removed from the layout while not recording, the start and the stop are not announced.
